description: Version bumps of Passbolt stay human-reviewed pull requests: the container migrates Passbolt's database on every start, and Passbolt documents no way back to an older version once that has happened.

packageRules.description: Passbolt publishes no plain version tags: every release is tagged per image flavour (`5.16.0-1-ce`, `5.16.0-1-ce-non-root`, `5.16.0-1-ce-openshift`), where `-1` is the revision of the image built for that release, which does get bumped (`5.10.0-2`). `passbolt_version` holds the version and the revision (`passbolt_container_image_tag` re-adds the flavour), so `extractVersion` strips the flavour this role deploys off the tags, and the regex versioning compares the revision as a number, where semver would read it as a pre-release.
